results_due: late January to mid-February 2027, going by when Q2 was reported (28 Oct to 6 Nov)
reasoning: Management gives no numbers; it expects 'strong momentum' and more traded clients than last year. Q2 revenue was ₹800 Cr (+14% on Q1) with options ADT of ₹12.0 lakh Cr. We assume roughly flat volumes, so about ₹810 Cr (+22% on Q3 FY26's ₹666 Cr).
Margin: Screener's operating margin was 76% in Q2 and 70% in Q1; the company reported 78% EBITDA in Q2. We use 75%.
Tax rose to ₹185 Cr in Q2, so PAT is about 57% of revenue; we keep that ratio.
risks: Commodity volatility fades and options volumes fall
Another tax or other-income swing in the quarter
caveat: MCX's reported EBITDA (₹664 Cr in Q2) is higher than Screener's operating profit (₹611 Cr); estimates are on Screener's rows.
